name: @parel/agents-md
description: Loads AGENTS.md files from the sandbox working directory, and from the subdirectories the model works in, into the system prompt.

config.root: Optional directory to read AGENTS.md from. Defaults to the workspace root when @parel/workspace has one, else the sandbox's working directory.
config.maxChars: Optional limit on the characters injected across all loaded AGENTS.md files (defaults to 32000). Text past it is cut, and the model is told what was cut.
